privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.text:
Privacy policy

 Introduction
This Privacy Policy describes how Tailormade (“we,” “our,” or “us”) collects, uses, discloses, and protects personal information obtained from users (“you” or “your”) of our website and services.
By accessing or using our website, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to the terms of this Privacy Policy.
Information We Collect
We may collect and process the following categories of personal data:

Personal Identification InformationIncluding, but not limited to:

Full nameContact numberEmail addressBilling and shipping address

Transactional Information

Details of products purchasedOrder historyPayment confirmation details (processed via secure third-party payment providers; we do not store full payment card details)

Technical Information

Internet Protocol (IP) addressBrowser type and versionDevice identifiersWebsite interaction data and analytics

Lawful Basis for Processing

We process your personal data on the following legal bases:

Performance of a contract (order processing and fulfillment)Compliance with legal obligationsLegitimate business interests (service improvement, fraud prevention)Your consent (for marketing communications, where applicable)

Use of Personal Information

Your personal data may be used for the following purposes:

To process, manage, and deliver ordersTo communicate with you regarding transactions or inquiriesTo provide customer service and after-sales supportTo improve our products, services, and user experienceTo send promotional communications, subject to your consent

Disclosure of Information

We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes.
We may disclose your information to:

Payment processing providersLogistics and delivery partnersIT and service providers supporting our operationsRegulatory or legal authorities where required by law

All third parties are contractually obligated to maintain the confidentiality and security of your data.
Data Security
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to safeguard personal data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration.
Notwithstanding the above, no electronic transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Data Retention
Personal data will be retained only for as long as necessary to:

Fulfill the purposes outlined in this policyComply with legal and regulatory obligationsResolve disputes and enforce agreements8. Your Rights

Subject to applicable laws, you have the right to:

Request access to your personal dataRequest rectification of inaccurate or incomplete dataRequest erasure of your personal dataObject to or restrict certain processing activitiesWithdraw consent for marketing communications at any time

Requests may be submitted using the contact details below.
Cookies and Tracking Technologies
Our website may utilize cookies and similar technologies to enhance functionality, analyze usage patterns, and improve user experience.
You may modify your browser settings to decline cookies; however, this may affect certain functionalities of the website.
Third-Party Websites
Our website may contain links to external websites. Tailormade is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of such third-party sites.
Amendments to This Policy
We reserve the right to amend this Privacy Policy at our sole discretion. Any changes will be effective immediately upon publication on our website.
Governing Law
This Privacy Policy shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Qatar.
Contact Information
For any questions, requests, or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact:

TailormadeEmail: tm@growiseqatar.com

refund-policy.title: Refund policy
refund-policy.text:
Refund policy

 We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. If for any reason you are not, please review our policy below:
Returns & Exchanges:
Items may be returned or exchanged within 3 days from the date of purchase, provided they are unused, undamaged, unwashed, and in their original condition. All original packaging, accessories, plastic and paper tags, certificates (if applicable), and the original invoice must be included. (delivery and fullfillment charges might be applied).
Refund Process:
Approved returns will be refunded via the original payment method. Please allow 7–14 business days for the refund to be processed, depending on your bank’s procedures.
Non-Returnable Items:
Customized or discounted items are not eligible for return or exchange unless they have a verified manufacturing defect.

Liability Disclaimer:
We are not responsible for damages caused by misuse or failure to follow product care or usage instructions.
Right to Refuse:
We reserve the right to decline any return or exchange request that does not meet the above conditions.
If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to contact our customer service team.
